# Twitter Hide Ads v3.0.0

## A hand-written Brainfuck policy core, compiled ahead of time

This release moves every filtering decision into Brainfuck, without changing what the module removes.

### Changed

- The filtering and decision policy is now three hand-written Brainfuck programs in `libtwitterbf.so` (`brainfuck/src/post.bf`, `action.bf`, `discovery.bf`), compiled ahead of time to C and then to native code with the NDK. There is no interpreter in the APK.
  - `post`: the entry-identifier grammar (segment boundaries, nested `conversationthread-…` and `search-conversation-…` prefixes, the 256-character limit), the "mentions promoted" ambiguity rule, verdict precedence, Video Tab item classes, the safe-mixed-batch rule and the copy and verification checks.
  - `action`: whether a value found by the fallback walk names a promoted post action.
  - `discovery`: render and Video Tab boundary eligibility, scores and thresholds, the exact-profile version table, and the discovery and traversal limits.
- Hooks, DexKit discovery, reflection, caching and Kotlin list rebuilding stay in Java. Each render makes one `@FastNative` call with the post's text fields and a metadata flag, and allocates nothing.
- Faster on a Pixel 8 Pro (release build): an organic post is classified in 2.4 µs (was 14.9 µs), a promoted post in 1.1 µs (was 6.1 µs), a 20-item Video Tab batch in 6.8 µs (was 275 µs).
- Fails open on any policy failure: a missing library or ABI mismatch installs no hook, and an oversized, malformed or budget-exhausted request keeps the content.
- New adaptive vector launcher icon — a struck-through shield over the X mark — with a themed (monochrome) layer.
- Per-render boundary observation logs are debug-only; block logs now carry policy counters.
- CI is split into test, build and release jobs. Signing secrets exist only in the release job, and the build checks that every native library ships in the APK.
- The README follows the ThreadsHideAds layout; the design is documented in `docs/BRAINFUCK_ARCHITECTURE.md` and each program has a normative specification in `docs/policy/`.

### Also in this release

- Timeline models are classified `PROMOTED`, `ORGANIC` or `UNKNOWN`. A confident organic entry identifier skips the reflective action-graph walk, and the walk's result is cached per model instance.
- Entry identifiers must match the whole-value grammar, so `not-promoted-x`, `unpromoted-1` or free text containing `promoted-` never count.
- Adaptive boundaries are witnessed at runtime and unhooked after 12 invocations without a post-like model.
- The `DexFile` fallback covers `com.x.urt`, `com.x.jetfuel` and `com.x.mappers`, post package first.
- Video Tab replacements are built through the persistent list's own builder; the dynamic-proxy emulation is removed.
- Release-build logs redact entry identifiers, and the unique-block key set is bounded to 512 entries.

### Verified

- Parity with the 2.1.0 Java policy, kept as a frozen test oracle: 411 162 old-versus-new comparisons per run on the JVM and on arm64, including every character from U+0000 to U+FFFF, plus randomized, malformed-frame, concurrency and "organic is never blocked" tests.
- On a Pixel 8 Pro, Android 17, Vector 2.2, X 12.28.0-prod.01: a cold DexKit rescan scored by the Brainfuck policy selected the same 9 boundaries with the same scores as 2.1.0; promoted posts blocked before render on the Home timeline and in post detail (`conversationthread-<id>-promoted-tweet-<id>-<hash>`); organic posts and replies untouched; search functional; Video Tab batches of 13, 24 and 35 entries filtered to 11, 22 and 31 with paging intact; no policy failures, crashes or ANRs.

No promoted search entry was served during the session. LSPatch, 32-bit and x86 devices were not run for this release.

### Version metadata

- Version name: `3.0.0`
- Android version code: `34`
- Git tag: `v3.0.0`
- APK filename: `TwitterHideAds-v3.0.0.apk`

### Updating

Install the v3.0.0 APK over v2.1.0, keep X (`com.twitter.android`) as the module's only scope, then force-stop and reopen X once. Confirm the framework log reports `policyCore=brainfuck-aot abi=1.0` followed by `enforcement=ACTIVE_ADAPTIVE`.

First release in the Xposed Module Repository.

Removes promoted posts from the X Android app on the Home timeline, in post detail, in search, and in the full-screen Video Tab. Requires a framework implementing the modern Xposed API 101 or newer: Vector with root, or the JingMatrix fork of LSPatch without.

The application ID is io.github.mrxsin.twitterhideads. If you previously installed a build under the old my.MrxSiN prefix, this installs alongside it rather than upgrading it, so uninstall the old copy.

# Twitter Hide Ads

Removes promoted posts from the official X Android app. Suppression happens before Compose renders the post, so an advertisement leaves no gap and no placeholder behind.

## What it removes

- Promoted posts on the Home timeline.
- Promoted posts nested inside a post detail view and inside search results.
- Promoted videos in the full-screen Video Tab, filtered at the data layer before the pager is created.

Ordinary posts, replies and search results are passed through untouched.

## Scope

The module declares a static scope of:

```text
com.twitter.android
```

`META-INF/xposed/scope.list` carries that declaration, so no scope selection is required in the manager. Do not add other applications.

## Requirements

- A framework implementing the modern Xposed API, version 101 or newer. The legacy `de.robv.android.xposed` API is not used, so a framework implementing only that API cannot load this module.
  - **Rooted:** [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) on Android 8.1 or newer, with Magisk or KernelSU and Zygisk enabled.
  - **Rootless:** [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch), the `JingMatrix` fork. It embeds Vector into a patched X APK and loads modern libxposed modules through the same runtime. The archived `LSPosed/LSPatch` build predates the modern API and cannot load this module.
- Android 8.0 (API 26) or newer.
- The official X application (`com.twitter.android`).

## Installation

1. Install the APK from the release attached to this repository.
2. Enable **Twitter Hide Ads** in the framework manager. With LSPatch, select it when patching X in manager mode, or embed it in integrated mode.
3. Force-stop X once, then reopen it.
4. Framework log entries are tagged:

```text
[TwitterHideAds]
```

## How it works

X ships a fully obfuscated, Compose-rendered timeline whose class and method names change with almost every release, so the module resolves its hooks structurally at runtime rather than by name.

Discovery is deferred until `Application.attach()`, when X has supplied its real application context and final class loader. If the installed X version matches one of the validated builds, an exact compatibility profile is used. Otherwise DexKit enumerates the application's static `void` methods, and each candidate is scored by the role its parameters play — a `Composer` followed by the compiler-generated `$changed` mask, a post model in first position, and any `Modifier` or layout-scope parameters in between — rather than by parameter position. Every boundary at or above the activation threshold is hooked, because the Kotlin Compose compiler emits both a defaulted and a non-defaulted entry point for a single composable.

Each resolved boundary is deoptimized through `XposedInterface.deoptimize`. ART inlines these small composables into their callers, and without deoptimization a compiled caller keeps running its inlined copy and the hook is never reached.

At render time a post model is classified from its own fields: an entry identifier carrying the `promoted-` token, or a promoted-metadata field, with a bounded action-graph walk as fallback where that metadata class has itself been obfuscated away. Only the Home timeline names an entry `promoted-tweet-<id>-<hash>`; every surface that nests a post inside a module prefixes its own entry, so the same advertisement arrives as `conversationthread-<id>-promoted-tweet-<id>-<hash>` in a post detail. Matching the token at any `-` segment boundary is what makes suppression app-wide rather than Home-only.

Resolved boundaries are cached by X version and APK fingerprint, and rescanned after an X update. Unresolved boundaries fail open, so the timeline is never left blank.

## Validation

Validated on device against X `12.23.1-prod.01` under Vector 2.2. The adaptive resolver installed 11 deoptimized boundaries reporting `enforcement=ACTIVE_ADAPTIVE`, and promoted entries were blocked before render on both the Home timeline and in post detail. Video Tab dataset filtering remains scoped to callers under `com.x.video.tab`.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Suggested action |
| --- | --- |
| Promoted posts still appear | Confirm the module is enabled and check whether the log reports `enforcement=ACTIVE_ADAPTIVE`. `FAIL_OPEN_NO_BOUNDARY` means no boundary was resolved. |
| Hooks install but nothing is blocked | Check `deoptimized=` in the initialization line. `0` alongside `deoptimizeSupported=false` means the framework interface was never attached to the module entry. |
| `no-structural-candidate` after an update | X changed its render boundary shape. Capture the `DexKit structural query` and `Adaptive boundary` log lines and open an issue. |
| Stale boundary after an X update | Resolution is cached by X version and APK fingerprint and should rescan automatically. Force-stop X once to trigger a fresh resolution. |

## Credits

| Project | Contribution |
| --- | --- |
| [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) by LuckyPray | Runtime DEX parsing and discovery of obfuscated classes and methods. Apache-2.0. |
| [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) by JingMatrix | The ART hooking framework, and the method deoptimization used to reach inlined composables. GPL-3.0. |
| [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) by JingMatrix | Embeds Vector into a patched APK, which is how this module runs without root. GPL-3.0. |
| [libxposed API](https://github.com/libxposed/api) | The modern Xposed module API this module compiles against. Apache-2.0. |

## Disclaimer

Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp. or Twitter. The module modifies the app's behaviour in memory on the user's own device; it does not redistribute or patch the X APK, and it transmits nothing off the device. Provided for educational and personal use. App updates may break the hooks without notice.

# Twitter 隐藏广告

从官方 X Android 应用程序中删除推广帖子。抑制发生在 Compose 呈现帖子之前，因此广告不会留下间隙，也不会留下占位符。

## 它删除了什么

- 在主页时间轴上推广的帖子。
- 嵌套在帖子详细信息视图和搜索结果中的推荐帖子。
- 全屏视频选项卡中的推荐视频，在创建寻呼机之前在数据层进行过滤。

普通帖子、回复和搜索结果均不受影响地传递。

## 范围

该模块声明静态范围：

````文本
com.twitter.android
````

`META-INF/xposed/scope.list` 带有该声明，因此管理器中不需要选择范围。不要添加其他应用程序。

## 要求

- 实现现代 Xpose API 版本 101 或更高版本的框架。未使用旧版“de.robv.android.xposed” API，因此仅实现该 API 的框架无法加载此模块。
  - **已 Root：** Android 8.1 或更高版本上的 [Vector](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector)，并启用 Magisk 或 KernelSU 和 Zygisk。
  - **无根：** [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch)，`JingMatrix` 分支。它将 Vector 嵌入到修补的 X APK 中，并通过相同的运行时加载现代 libxposed 模块。存档的“LSPosed/LSPatch”构建早于现代 API，无法加载此模块。
- Android 8.0 (API 26) 或更高版本。
- 官方 X 应用程序 (`com.twitter.android`)。

## 安装

1. 从附加到此存储库的版本安装 APK。
2. 在框架管理器中启用 **Twitter 隐藏广告**。使用LSPatch，在管理器模式下修补X时选择它，或者在集成模式下嵌入它。
3. 强制停止 X 一次，然后重新打开它。
4. 框架日志条目被标记：

````文本
[Twitter隐藏广告]
````

## 它是如何工作的

X 提供了一个完全混淆的、Compose 渲染的时间线，其类和方法名称几乎在每个版本中都会发生变化，因此该模块在运行时从结构上而不是通过名称来解析其挂钩。

发现被推迟到“Application.attach()”，此时 X 提供了其真实的应用程序上下文和最终的类加载器。如果安装的 X 版本与经过验证的版本之一匹配，则使用精确的兼容性配置文件。否则，DexKit 会枚举应用程序的静态“void”方法，并且每个候选方法都根据其参数所扮演的角色进行评分 - 一个“Composer”，后跟编译器生成的“$changed”掩码，第一个位置的后模型，以及中间的任何“Modifier”或布局范围参数，而不是参数位置。处于或高于激活阈值的每个边界都会被挂钩，因为 Kotlin Compose 编译器会为单个可组合项发出默认入口点和非默认入口点。

每个解析的边界都通过“XposedInterface.deoptimize”进行去优化。 ART 将这些小型可组合项内联到其调用者中，并且在不进行去优化的情况下，已编译的调用者将继续运行其内联副本，并且永远不会到达挂钩。

在渲染时，后模型根据其自己的字段进行分类：带有“promoted-”标记的条目标识符，或一个promoted-metadata字段，并以有界动作图行走作为后备，其中该元数据类本身已被混淆。只有主页时间线命名条目“promoted-tweet-<id>-<hash>”；在模块内嵌套帖子的每个表面都为其自己的条目添加前缀，因此相同的广告以“conversationthread-<id>-promoted-tweet-<id>-<hash>”形式到达帖子详细信息中。在任何“-”段边界处匹配标记使得抑制在应用程序范围内而不是仅在家庭范围内。

已解析的边界由 X 版本和 APK 指纹缓存，并在 X 更新后重新扫描。未解决的边界无法打开，因此时间线永远不会留空。

## 验证

在设备上根据 Vector 2.2 下的 X `12.23.1-prod.01` 进行验证。自适应解析器安装了 11 个去优化的边界，报告“enforcement=ACTIVE_ADAPTIVE”，并且在主页时间轴和帖子详细信息中渲染之前，提升的条目被阻止。视频选项卡数据集过滤的范围仍然仅限于“com.x.video.tab”下的调用者。

## 故障排除

|问题 |建议采取的行动 |
| --- | --- |
|推广帖子仍然出现 |确认模块已启用，查看日志是否有“enforcement=ACTIVE_ADAPTIVE”的报告。 `FAIL_OPEN_NO_BOUNDARY` 表示没有边界被解析。 |
|挂钩已安装但没有被阻止 |检查初始化行中的“deoptimized=”。 “0”和“deoptimizeSupported=false”一起表示框架接口从未附加到模块条目。 |
|更新后的“无结构候选”| X 更改了其渲染边界形状。捕获“DexKit 结构查询”和“自适应边界”日志行并提出问题。 |
| X 更新后过时的边界 |分辨率由 X 版本和 APK 指纹缓存，并应自动重新扫描。强制停止 X 一次以触发新的解决方案。 |

## 学分

|项目|贡献 |
| --- | --- |
| LuckyPray | [DexKit](https://github.com/LuckyPray/DexKit) |运行时 DEX 解析和发现混淆的类和方法。阿帕奇-2.0。 |
| [矢量](https://github.com/JingMatrix/Vector) by JingMatrix | ART 挂钩框架以及用于实现内联可组合项的方法去优化。 GPL-3.0。 |
| [LSPatch](https://github.com/JingMatrix/LSPatch) 作者：JingMatrix |将 Vector 嵌入到已修补的 APK 中，这就是该模块无需 root 即可运行的方式。 GPL-3.0。 |
| [libxpose API](https://github.com/libxposed/api) |该模块编译所针对的现代 Xposed 模块 API。阿帕奇-2.0。 |

## 免责声明

不隶属于 X Corp. 或 Twitter，也不受其认可或赞助。该模块修改应用程序在用户自己设备上内存中的行为；它不会重新分发或修补 X APK，并且不会从设备传输任何内容。供教育和个人使用。应用程序更新可能会破坏挂钩，恕不另行通知。
